title: Scaling electrolyser factories in India
description: Hydrotek Systems' CTO on what it takes to make electrolysers in India at scale: suppliers for membranes and catalysts, testing every stack before it ships, and why buyers keep asking about lead times. (Sample episode.)

chapters.title: From a 50 kW stack to a 1 MW container
Testing every stack before it leaves the factory
What buyers ask for, and what they should ask for

transcript:
H2 India:
Welcome to Hydrogen Leaders. Today we're talking about factories: what it takes to make electrolysers in India, at scale.
Anand Deshpande:
Thanks for having me. The short answer is that the stack is the easy part. The hard part is everything around it.
H2 India:
What do you mean by everything around it?
Anand Deshpande:
Power electronics, gas cleaning, controls. That's where lead times come from.
